description: Source code for controller functions managing OpenAI assistants, including listing assistants, retrieving a single assistant, downloading files, and uploading files, with error handling and external service interactions.

methods.name: getAllOpenaiAssistants
methods.description: Handles request to list all available OpenAI assistants, requiring a credential query parameter.

methods.name: getSingleOpenaiAssistant
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OpenAI assistant by ID, requiring credential and ID parameters.

methods.name: getFileFromAssistant
methods.description: Downloads a file associated with an assistant, retrieving chatflow and workspace info, and streaming the file.

methods.name: uploadAssistantFiles
methods.description: Uploads files to an assistant, validating file types and handling multiple files.
